candidate_ideas.statement: Under finite-type and suitable catenary or biequidimensional hypotheses, compare the B_3 and B_4 incidence dimensions using codimension of the jump stratum.
Establish a 15-dimensional balanced tetragonal base component from simple branching together with a stack-level stabilizer analysis.
Prove the CE relative-canonical normalization needed to identify W_5≅ω_C^2(-D), and hence L≅ω_C(-D), for the tetragonal pencil divisor D.
Exclude balanced non-primitive degree-four pencils in order to prove that the h^0(L)=4 stratum is empty.
Prove that the reduced-support open in every relevant |L_b| is nonempty.
Recover the tetragonal pencil from L and prove the required stack-level generic finiteness or full faithfulness of the map to M_{6,6}.
Determine whether the numerical excess 2 has a genuine local deformation-theoretic interpretation through ideal-depth or conormal calculations.

established_facts.evidence: The canonical degree formula is deg(W_f|_C)=4g+12-4f; substituting g=6 and f=5 gives deg(W_5)=16 and deg(L)=16-10=6.
established_facts.statement: For the balanced tetragonal splitting F=O(4)⊕O(5), the CE bundle W_5 has degree 16 and L=W_5⊗ω_C^{-1} has degree 6 on a genus-6 fibre.

established_facts.evidence: FND-0062 gives degree -4 and vanishing for the f=4 obstruction; FND-0063 gives degree zero for the f=5 obstruction and the equivalence O_C(Γ)≅W_5⊗ω_C^{-1}.
established_facts.statement: The f=4 obstruction vanishes, while the f=5 evaluation obstruction for a degree-six divisor Γ vanishes precisely outside the condition O_C(Γ)≅L.

established_facts.evidence: The visible H3 input identifies I_k with the projectivization of a rank-k vector bundle. Projectivization has pure relative dimension k-1, giving dimensions dim(Y)+2 on B_3 and dim(Y)+3 on B_4.
established_facts.statement: On a constant-h^0 stratum B_k, the reduced incidence I_k is a P^{k-1}-bundle; hence its components over a base component Y have dimension dim(Y)+k-1.

established_facts.evidence: The visible H2 containment places B_4 inside the locus of hyperelliptic fibres whose tetragonal map factors through the hyperelliptic double cover, and I_4 maps to B_4.
established_facts.statement: Every component of I_4 is supported over the hyperelliptic non-primitive locus.

established_facts.evidence: The ordered incidence is a finite étale S_6-cover of the reduced-support open in |L_b|≅P^{k-1}; a nonempty open in an irreducible projective space has the same dimension, and finite étale maps preserve dimension.
established_facts.statement: The ordered distinct-divisor incidence over B_k has geometric fibres that are either empty or equidimensional of dimension k-1.

established_facts.evidence: FND-0107 identifies the full incidence with Sym^6(C/B)×_{Pic^6_{C/B}}B and uses separatedness of the relative Picard for closedness; the reduced-support locus is the complement of the finite image of the big diagonal.
established_facts.statement: The full Abel–Jacobi incidence of effective degree-six divisors representing L is closed, whereas its reduced-support sublocus is open.

established_facts.evidence: Evaluation of a section and its first jet imposes at most two independent linear conditions on the k-dimensional space H^0(L_b), so the kernel has dimension at least k-2.
established_facts.statement: For b∈B_k and p∈C_b, h^0(L_b(-2p))≥k-2≥1; consequently |L_b| contains a divisor nonreduced at p.

established_facts.evidence: The reduced divisor supplies nonemptiness, the jet-kernel calculation supplies a nonreduced divisor, and a nonempty proper open subset of the irreducible space P^{k-1} is not closed.
established_facts.statement: If |L_b| contains a reduced divisor, then its reduced-support locus is a nonempty proper open subset of |L_b| and is not closed in that fibre.
For a map between bundles of ranks k and k-1, the rank locus rk(φ)≤k-3 has expected determinantal codimension 6.
On B_3, χ(L)=1 and h^0(L)=3 imply h^1(L)=2.

established_facts.evidence: The projective-bundle formula gives 15+2=17, while dim(M_{6,6})=3·6-3+6=21 and 21-17=4.
established_facts.statement: A B_3 component of dimension 15 has incidence-source dimension 17; relative to M_{6,6} of dimension 21 this gives the numerical codimension 4.
Riemann–Hurwitz gives total ramification degree 18 for a genus-6 degree-four cover of P^1.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A nonempty open subset of an irreducible locally Noetherian scheme need not retain the ambient Krull dimension, and codimension need not satisfy dim(X_4)+c=dim(X) without additional finite-type, catenary, or biequidimensional hypotheses. A one-dimensional DVR spectrum with its closed point as X_4 has a zero-dimensional open generic point.
invalid_steps.statement: From an irreducible locally Noetherian component X of dimension d meeting B_3 and a closed jump locus X_4 of pure codimension c, infer unconditionally that dim(X∩B_3)=d and dim(X_4)=d-c.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: The same total dimension can arise from a 14-dimensional base with fibre dimension 3; the converse is valid only after fixing the B_3 fibre dimension to be 2.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer that a source of dimension 17 must have a 15-dimensional base and fibre dimension 2.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: A source-dimension count does not determine the dimension of its image, generic fibre dimension, stabilizers, component purity, closure, or the presence of larger special or unbalanced components.
invalid_steps.statement: Promote the count 15+2=17 to a generically finite pure-codimension-4 image in M_{6,6}.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: An open subset may also be closed. Non-closedness requires both a reduced member and a boundary point represented by a nonreduced member in the same relevant component or fibre.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer non-closedness of the reduced-support incidence solely from its openness.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Images of open subsets under a general classifying morphism need be neither open nor closed; separate properness, closure, and special-locus analysis is required.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer that openness of the incidence source controls closedness of its image in M_{6,6}.

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Expected determinantal codimension and numerical excess do not determine the depth or number of generators of the actual local ideal; local ideal-depth or conormal calculations are necessary.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer local complete-intersection, regularity, purity, or Gysin applicability from the excess calculation 6-4=2 or from its equality with h^1(L).

invalid_steps.mathematical_reason: Total ramification degree counts ramification multiplicities, whereas the number of branch points equals 18 only when all ramification is simple.
invalid_steps.statement: Infer the branch-point count b=18, and therefore b-3=15, from total ramification degree 18 without a branching hypothesis.

unresolved_dependencies.statement: Finite-type, catenary, or biequidimensional hypotheses sufficient for the jump-stratum dimension comparison.
The dimension and stabilizers of the relevant balanced tetragonal base components, including simple branching.
Whether a non-primitive degree-four pencil can have balanced splitting F=O(4)⊕O(5), equivalently whether B_4 is empty in the balanced primitive locus.
Nonemptiness and density of the reduced-support open on every relevant geometric fibre.
CE relative-canonical normalization and the identification W_5≅ω_C^2(-D).
Generic finiteness, pencil recovery, automorphism control, and stack-level full faithfulness for the map to M_{6,6}.
An exhaustive component analysis including hyperelliptic, unbalanced CE, and other special-curve strata.
Image closure, image purity, and actual codimensions inside M_{6,6}.
Local ideal-depth, conormal, lci, and Gysin calculations for the incidence image.
Control of the mixed-local-system connecting map affecting the relevant weight-26 cohomology quotient.
Tate type and survival or cancellation of all contributions to the exact weight-26 cohomology target.
